Subject: Update on Your Application for the Marketing Position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the marketing position at our company. We appreciate the effort you put into your application and the opportunity to learn more about your background.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience aligns more closely with our current needs. Please know that this decision is not a reflection of your skills or potential; rather, it reflects the specific direction we are taking for this role.

We were impressed by your qualifications and wish you the very best in your job search and future professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
